tasks.name: ספור קטנים מ-11
tasks.note: Counts elements below a fixed threshold (only 8, 9, 10 qualify).

tasks.name: האם יש 15?
tasks.note: Existence test for one fixed value, answered as 15/0.

tasks.name: הראשון ועוד האחרון
tasks.note: Adds the first and last elements mod 16 (a single element counts twice; empty gives 0).

tasks.name: ארוכה מ-4?
tasks.note: Compares the list length with a constant and returns 15/0.

tasks.name: סכום האי-זוגיים
tasks.note: Conditional sum mod 16 over the odd elements only (empty or no odds gives 0).

tasks.name: הגדול פחות הראשון
tasks.note: Difference of two aggregates: the maximum minus the first element (empty gives 0).

tasks.name: כולם גדולים מ-9?
tasks.note: Universal test over the list, 15/0, with the empty list vacuously true (15).

tasks.name: זוגיים פחות אי-זוגיים
tasks.note: Difference of two conditional counts, wrapped mod 16 when negative.

tasks.name: השני בקטנו
tasks.note: Second-smallest element, needing two running minima (fewer than 2 elements gives 0).

tasks.name: ספור שיאים
tasks.src: l=>{ let m=-1,c=0; for(const x of l){ if(x>m){ m=x; c++; } } return c; }
tasks.note: Counts records (elements larger than everything before them): a loop with a running max and a decision.

tasks.name: אורך ההתחלה העולה
tasks.src: l=>{ if(!l.length) return 0; let i=1; while(i<l.length&&l[i]>l[i-1]) i++; return i; }
tasks.note: Length of the longest strictly increasing prefix: a loop that compares neighbours and stops early.

tasks.name: הגדול לפני הקטן?
tasks.note: Compares the positions of the max and the min: 15 if the max comes first, else 0 (fewer than 2 elements gives 0).
